LanguageData.GB_Intro: How often new people are men. Only people generated from now on are affected; your current pawns stay as they are.
LanguageData.GB_Joiners: People joining your colony: {0} men / {1} women
LanguageData.GB_JoinersTip: Wanderers who join, starting colonists and anyone the game makes for your faction. 50 % = the game's normal chance.
LanguageData.GB_OthersTip: Visitors, traders, raiders, refugees, slaves for sale, faction members … Off = the game's normal 50 %. Useful because many recruits come as prisoners or refugees.
LanguageData.GB_Note: Never changed: a gender asked for by a quest, a relative or a pawn kind, and races that have only one gender (for example female-only alien races) – they stay as their mod made them.
LanguageData.GB_Races_Desc: Chance of a man for each alien race. Untouched = the race's own value from its mod. A value set here replaces the race's own value and wins over the two sliders above, for every new person of that race.
LanguageData.GB_Race_Desc: Race {0}. Its own value from its mod: {1} men. Move the slider to override it.
LanguageData.GB_RaceReset_Desc: Back to the race's own value ({0} men).
LanguageData.GB_OthersHalf: Note: at 50 % nothing changes for everyone else (raiders, refugees, prisoners, slaves…). Most new colonists arrive this way – move the slider.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
LanguageData.GB_Profile: How often new people are men or women. Only people generated from now on.
LanguageData.GB_ProfGame_Card: 50 % men and 50 % women. The mod changes nothing.
LanguageData.GB_ProfWomen_Card: About 3 in 4 new people are women – colonists and everyone else.
LanguageData.GB_ProfMen_Card: About 3 in 4 new people are men – colonists and everyone else.
LanguageData.GB_ProfCustom_Card: Set the sliders yourself, separately for the colony and others.
LanguageData.GB_ProfileHint: The sliders are locked to the chosen option. Click Custom for your own values.
LanguageData.GB_ProfileHintCustom: Custom settings – sliders are unlocked. CHANGED = different from the game.
